title: Evaluating GPT-4 and ChatGPT on Japanese Medical Licensing Examinations
reasoning: The paper explicitly discusses "prohibited choices (禁忌肢)" in the Japanese medical licensing exam. These are choices that correspond to decisions that should be strictly avoided in medical practice in Japan, such as suggesting euthanasia. The paper evaluates how LLMs handle these ethically sensitive questions, demonstrating their potential failure to align with country-specific medical ethics and laws.
